mapper.select:
SELECT p.id, p.subject_id, s.subject_name, p.target_type, p.target_corp_code, p.target_id, p.target_name, p.permission_effect, p.include_child_departments, p.status, p.source, p.updated_at FROM subject_permission p INNER JOIN invoice_subject s ON s.id = p.subject_id
ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO subject_permission (subject_id, target_type, target_corp_code, target_id, target_name, permission_effect, include_child_departments, status, source, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{subjectId}, #{targetType}, #{targetCorpCode}, #{targetId}, #{targetName}, #{permissionEffect}, #{includeChildDepartments}, #{status}, #{source}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedAt}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE subject_permission SET status = #{status}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.corp_code, d.corp_name, d.ding_department_id, d.department_name, d.parent_department_id, d.status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ding_employee e WHERE e.department_id = d.id AND e.status = 'ACTIVE') AS employee_count FROM subject_permission p INNER JOIN ding_department d ON d.corp_code = p.target_corp_code AND d.ding_department_id = p.target_id AND d.status = 'ENABLED' WHERE p.subject_id = #{subjectId} AND p.target_type = 'DEPARTMENT' AND p.permission_effect = 'ALLOW' AND p.status = 'ENABLED' AND p.deleted = 0 ORDER BY d.corp_code ASC, d.sort_no ASC, d.id ASC

SELECT e.id AS employee_id, e.corp_code, e.corp_name, e.ding_user_id, e.employee_no, e.employee_name, e.department_name, e.mobile, p.permission_effect AS effect FROM subject_permission p INNER JOIN ding_employee e ON e.corp_code = p.target_corp_code AND e.ding_user_id = p.target_id AND e.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE p.subject_id = #{subjectId} AND p.target_type = 'USER' AND p.status = 'ENABLED' AND p.deleted = 0 ORDER BY e.corp_code ASC, e.employee_no ASC, e.id ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ding_employee e INNER JOIN invoice_subject s ON s.id = #{subjectId} AND s.deleted = 0 AND s.status = 'ENABLED' WHERE e.status = 'ACTIVE' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM subject_permission deny_rule WHERE deny_rule.subject_id = s.id AND deny_rule.target_type = 'USER' AND deny_rule.target_corp_code = e.corp_code AND deny_rule.target_id = e.ding_user_id AND deny_rule.permission_effect = 'DENY' AND deny_rule.status = 'ENABLED' AND deny_rule.deleted = 0 ) AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM subject_permission allow_user WHERE allow_user.subject_id = s.id AND allow_user.target_type = 'USER' AND allow_user.target_corp_code = e.corp_code AND allow_user.target_id = e.ding_user_id AND allow_user.permission_effect = 'ALLOW' AND allow_user.status = 'ENABLED' AND allow_user.deleted = 0 ) OR s.all_employee_visible = 1 OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ding_employee_department employee_department INNER JOIN ding_department d ON d.id = employee_department.department_id INNER JOIN subject_permission allow_department ON allow_department.target_corp_code = d.corp_code AND allow_department.target_id = d.ding_department_id WHERE employee_department.employee_id = e.id AND allow_department.subject_id = s.id AND allow_department.target_type = 'DEPARTMENT' AND allow_department.permission_effect = 'ALLOW' AND allow_department.status = 'ENABLED' AND allow_department.deleted = 0 AND d.status = 'ENABLED' ) )
